events.title: The dented brass bell
events.prose: Silas caught Tobin staring at the cracked ceiling tiles during the afternoon sparring session. He didn't say anything, but he stopped correcting Tobin's footwork for the rest of the week.

events.title: Unpaid tab at the diner
events.prose: Elias scribbled a new total on the grease-stained ledger after Tobin left without paying for the coffee. There was a heavy silence when their eyes met over the counter.

events.title: A spilled drink incident
events.prose: Lenora threw a glass of cheap gin toward the floor after Mickie made a joke about her latest performance. The glass shattered, but Mickie just laughed and offered to help clean it up.

events.title: The missing shipment notice
events.prose: Tobin found a crumpled note tucked into the crate of bruised apples. He kept the paper in his pocket, waiting for a moment that never seemed to arrive.

memories.text: Mickie laughed when a heavy hook caught him square in the jaw during a sparring session.
He offered to sweep up the gin shards after Lenora shattered her glass.
He watched Tobin stare blankly at the cracked ceiling tiles in the gym.
Elias watched Tobin walk away from the counter without paying for his coffee.
He scribbled the new debt into the grease-stained ledger.
He felt a heavy silence settle between him and Tobin after their eyes met.
Silas watched Tobin's gaze linger on the cracked ceiling tiles during the afternoon sparring session.
Silas stopped correcting Tobin's footwork for the remainder of that week.
Silas kept his mouth shut when he saw the hollow look in Tobin's eyes.
Lenora wore her brightest sequins to the Rusty Anchor and demanded the attention of every patron in the room.
She threw a glass of cheap gin at the floor after Mickie made a joke at her expense.
She watched Tobin linger near the ring long after the sparring session ended.
